Add constraints

class pygeox.constraint.ConstraintNamespace(scene)[source]

Bases: object

eq(a, b, description=None)[source]

Adds an equality constraint (a == b) to the scene. If ‘a’ is a square root expression, it squares both sides.

Parameters:

  • a (Expr | int | float)

  • b (Expr | int | float)

  • description (str | None)

Return type:

Equality | None

geq(a, b, description=None)[source]

Adds a ‘greater than or equal to’ constraint (a >= b) to the scene.

Parameters:

  • a (Expr | int | float)

  • b (Expr | int | float)

  • description (str | None)

Return type:

GreaterThan | None

gt(a, b, description=None)[source]

Adds a ‘greater than’ constraint (a > b) to the scene.

Parameters:

  • a (Expr | int | float)

  • b (Expr | int | float)

  • description (str | None)

Return type:

StrictGreaterThan | None

leq(a, b, description=None)[source]

Adds a ‘less than or equal to’ constraint (a <= b) to the scene.

Parameters:

  • a (Expr | int | float)

  • b (Expr | int | float)

  • description (str | None)

Return type:

LessThan | None

lt(a, b, description=None)[source]

Adds a ‘less than’ constraint (a < b) to the scene.

Parameters:

  • a (Expr | int | float)

  • b (Expr | int | float)

  • description (str | None)

Return type:

StrictLessThan | None

neq(a, b, description=None)[source]

Adds an inequality constraint (a != b) to the scene.

Parameters:

  • a (Expr | int | float)

  • b (Expr | int | float)

  • description (str | None)

Return type:

Unequality | None
